_comment: Alarm management for IAM user mcaffeine-erp-prefg-tool, account 157320387454.
Suggested policy name: erp-alarm-management
Probed 2026-09-07: cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm is DENIED for these keys today.
This is the policy that lifts that.
The account's only disk alarm, 'Email_Alert', is dead twice over:
- it watches namespace CWAgent, which holds 0 metrics (this app's agent
publishes to ERP/EC2 — see deploy/cloudwatch-agent-config.json)
- its dimension is InstanceId=i-0fe68f439de2aceaf, which is neither live
app instance (i-0a249d3d470e693d3, i-0d269978588f3c2da)
So it sits in INSUFFICIENT_DATA permanently and there is NO working disk
alarm. Fixing that needs PutMetricAlarm.
── THIS IS A WRITE GRANT, KEPT SEPARATE FOR THAT REASON ────────────────────
Every other observability permission is read-only. This one creates and
deletes alarms, so it lives in its own policy: attach it while fixing the
alarms, detach it afterwards, and the read-only tabs keep working.
DeleteAlarms is included because replacing 'Email_Alert' means removing it —
but note the name does NOT match the erp-* pattern below, so deleting that
specific alarm needs either a one-off console action or its ARN added here.
That is deliberate: a policy that can delete any alarm in the account is a
bigger grant than fixing one alarm warrants.
Scoped to alarm:erp-* so these keys cannot touch alarms belonging to anything
else in this shared account. Name replacements accordingly, e.g.
erp-disk-used-high, erp-mem-used-high, erp-rds-cpu-high
An alarm created outside that prefix will be refused by this policy.
DescribeAlarms is a list operation with no resource-level permissions, so it
stays on '*' — it is already granted by iam-policy-erp-app-deploy.json and is
repeated here only so this policy is useful standalone.
NOT granted: cloudwatch:PutMetricData. Nothing in this app publishes custom
metrics — the CloudWatch agent does that under the instance role, not these
keys. If app-level metrics are ever wanted, prefer EMF log lines (free, no
new permission) over PutMetricData.
